Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk: Preparing a Calm Trip for Your Companion Animal

Safe travel for a companion animal starts with careful planning and steady handling. Our review approach focuses on preventing avoidable stress, supporting the animal's comfort, and making each step clear for the traveler.

Before travel, gather the items that help your animal feel settled. Bring familiar food, approved treats, water, and any needed medication in secure containers. Keep the carrier clean, well ventilated, and large enough for the animal to stand, turn, and rest without strain. A blanket or toy with a familiar scent can also make the space feel more reassuring.

The animal's health and behavior matter as much as the equipment. A calm pet may adjust quickly, while a nervous one may need extra time and gentle introduction to the carrier. If the animal has special feeding, temperature, or medication needs, note those early so the care plan can account for them. The Companion Animal Travel Desk can help you match the plan to the species, temperament, and comfort needs involved.

Check-in is smoother when your papers, identification, and carrier are ready before you arrive. <<FACT F092>> Keep the animal close and avoid sudden movement or loud handling, since a quiet routine helps reduce stress. If the traveler is bringing more than one animal, use separate arrangements unless staff have confirmed a different setup is safe.

During boarding, follow the directions of the welcome team and the cabin or ground staff. They watch for safety concerns, including carrier placement, airflow, and signs of distress. If the animal appears overheated, agitated, or unwell, speak up at once so the situation can be reviewed before travel continues.

Aurelia Skyways aims for dependable companion travel, and that depends on clear preparation from both the traveler and our staff. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for guidance before your departure.
